help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or contact our support team.

help.q1: How do I make a booking on Trivgoo?
help.a1: To make a booking, simply search for your desired destination, select your travel dates, choose from our curated experiences, and proceed to checkout. You can pay securely using credit/debit cards, bank transfer, or digital wallets. You will receive a confirmation email once payment is processed.
help.a2: We accept major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), debit cards, bank transfers, and popular digital wallets including GoPay, OVO, and Dana. All payments are processed securely through our encrypted payment gateway.
help.q3: Can I change my booking after confirmation?
help.a3: Yes, you can modify your booking depending on the provider's policy. Log in to your account, go to "My Bookings," and select the booking you want to change. Changes may incur additional fees subject to availability.
help.a4: Absolutely. We use industry-standard SSL encryption and PCI-DSS compliant payment processors to ensure your payment information is fully protected. We never store your full credit card details on our servers.
help.a5: Cancellation policies vary per provider. Generally: (1) Cancellations 7+ days before departure get a full refund minus 5% processing fee, (2) 3-7 days get 50% refund, (3) Less than 3 days — no refund. Specific policies are shown at checkout.
help.q6: How do I cancel my booking?
help.a6: To cancel, log in to your account, navigate to "My Bookings," select the booking you want to cancel, and click "Cancel Booking." Follow the steps to complete cancellation. You will receive a confirmation email with refund details if applicable.
help.q7: How long does a refund take?
help.a7: Refunds are typically processed within 7-14 business days from the cancellation date. The exact time depends on your payment method and bank. You will receive an email notification once the refund is processed.
help.q8: What happens if the provider cancels?
help.a8: If a provider cancels your booking, you will receive a full refund with no cancellation fee. We will contact you promptly and help find an alternative if desired.
help.q9: How do I create an account?
help.a9: Click "Sign Up" in the top right corner, enter your name, email address, and create a password. You can also sign up using your Google or Facebook account for faster registration. Verify your email address to activate your account.
help.q10: I forgot my password. What should I do?
help.a10: Click "Sign In" then select "Forgot Password." Enter your registered email address and we will send you a password reset link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.
help.q11: Can I change my email address?
help.a11: Yes, you can update your email address in account settings. Go to "Profile Settings," click "Edit Profile," update your email, and verify the new address via the confirmation link we send.
help.q12: How do I delete my account?
help.a12: To delete your account, contact our support team at cs@trivgoo.com with your account details. Note that this action is permanent and you will lose access to all booking history and saved preferences.
help.a13: While travel insurance is not mandatory, we strongly recommend it for protection against unexpected situations such as trip cancellations, medical emergencies, or lost baggage. We can help arrange travel insurance through our partners.
help.q14: What documents do I need for international travel?
help.a14: For international travel, you typically need a valid passport (at least 6 months validity), the appropriate visa, and any required health certificates or vaccination records. Requirements vary by destination — make sure to check before booking.
help.q15: Does Trivgoo assist with visa applications?
help.a15: Yes, we provide visa assistance services for many destinations. Contact our support team with your travel details and we will guide you through the visa application process and requirements.
help.q16: Is airport transfer included in tour packages?
help.a16: Airport transfer is included in some tour packages but not all. Check the package details when booking to see what is included. You can also add airport transfer services separately at checkout.
help.q17: How do I contact customer service?
help.a17: You can reach our customer service team via email at cs@trivgoo.com, WhatsApp at +62 821-4444-3784, or live chat on our website. Our service hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 WIB, Sat 09:00-15:00 WIB.
help.a18: We offer 24/7 emergency support for travelers on active trips. For general inquiries, our regular service hours are Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 WIB, Sat 09:00-15:00 WIB.
help.a19: Our support team is fluent in Indonesian and English. We can also arrange support in other languages upon request.
help.q20: How quickly will I get a response?
help.a20: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours on business days. For urgent matters or travelers on active trips, we provide immediate assistance via our 24/7 emergency hotline.

privacy.tentang_p3: We provide websites and services available online, through the website: www.trivgoo.com or the mobile website, m.trivgoo.com, or the trivgoo.com mobile application for iOS & trivgoo.com for Android, as well as various access points, media, devices, and platforms ("Online Services"), both currently available and those that may become available in the future.

privacy.tentang_p5: To maintain your trust in us, we are committed to always keeping your personal data confidential. Therefore, we encourage you to read this Privacy Notice and keep it updated to understand our practices regarding your personal data.
privacy.tentang_p6: This Privacy Notice covers the following:
privacy.tentang_list_2: How We Use Your Personal Data;
privacy.data_pribadi_p1: We collect personal data when you interact with our Online Services. The type of data we collect depends on the services you use and how you interact with us.
privacy.data_pribadi_p2: The personal data we collect includes, among others: full name, email address, phone number, date of birth, address, payment data, and your travel preferences.
privacy.akun_p1: When you create an account or make a booking, we collect information you provide directly, including:
privacy.akun_li5: Information about other travel participants if relevant

privacy.transaksi_li2: Bank account information for direct transfers
